method: Google web search in a real browser session. For each query we recorded the organic result titles in page order, with the domain and breadcrumb Google displayed. caveats: SERPs vary by physical location, device, personalization, ads, Local Pack, time, and search history.

No keyword volumes, traffic, or backlink counts were collected. None may be inferred from this file.
